messages:
DealDesk Bot: Heads-up: Rate card v3.1 will publish 2026-05-01. Some legacy SKUs will be rebaselined; see internal rollout notes.
Nina (Sales): Quick question — I have a POC with Medrix that started 2026-03-20. They're on `pro-128` and worried their quote will change mid-POC. What's the guidance?
Mari - RevOps: If POC started before the effective date we can offer mapped SKU + a temporary quoting buffer. Need deal details to create a DealDesk request.
Nina (Sales): POC ends 2026-06-01; avg usage ~70k tokens/day. Will we auto-map to `core-std` or something else?
Sam Eng: Mapping note: `pro-128` -> `core-std` for hosted; `pro-128-ded` -> `core-dedicated-s1`. Performance slightly different; customers should be notified if they care about p95 latency.
Tom (Finance): For quoting buffer, we usually allow a 60-day protected rate for active POCs (not a revenue credit). If Sales needs a one-time credit to match old unit economics, DealDesk review required.
Jia (Legal): Clause to use if we grant special protection: "Customer shall receive protected pricing for active POCs beginning before 2026-05-01 for a period of 60 days following the published effective date. Protected pricing applies to SKUs explicitly listed in the associated DealDesk approval."
Nina (Sales): Can RevOps generate a pasteable quote snippet I can drop into the PO?
Mari - RevOps: Paste this block into the quote body:
```
legacy_sku: pro-128
mapped_sku: core-std
protection_days: 60
one_auto_credit: false
note: "If customer requests a unit-price credit, submit DD-8479 with usage estimate."
```
Sam Eng: Also mention fallback variant for cost-optimized runs: `core-std-quant`.
Nina (Sales): Thanks. I'll open DD-8479 now and attach usage numbers.
DealDesk Bot: New DealDesk request created: DD-8479 by Nina (Sales) 4dd awaiting RevOps review.
Tom (Finance): For quick math: 70k tokens/day * 30 = 2.1M tokens/month. If we needed to bridge a $0.008 delta/token that's ~ $16.8k/month. Flag me on DD-8479 and I'll fast-track.
Mari - RevOps: Approving interim protected rate routing for this POC pending Finance confirmation on DD-8479. We'll scope protection to Hosted + Dedicated S1 and exclude Dedicated GPU-XL until separate mapping verified.
Jia (Legal): I'll attach the short clause to the DealDesk approval once Finance confirms.
Nina (Sales): Great — target: finalize by next Tue so customer can sign. Will update thread when DD-8479 is ready. :thumbsup:
